image_description: A close-up shot of a young child in a pink shirt blowing soap bubbles. Several translucent bubbles with iridescent surfaces are visible in the foreground and mid-ground. A second child is visible in the background, slightly out of focus. The scene appears to be indoors or in a sheltered area with bright lighting. There is text on a red surface in the immediate foreground.
